purpose: the prespecified (N replicates, K change events) ladder referenced by STAGE_C1_PROTOCOL.md section 8
rule: take the FIRST rung, in the listed order, whose smoke-estimated bootstrap SE(D_Delta) <= 0.010 at EVERY Delta, subject to N >= 100. The chosen rung is then used for every policy and every shift. Replication is never increased for cells close to passing.
cycles_between_blocks: chosen in smoke by measuring recovery; the same value is then used for every policy and shift
